content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Choose exact value types and reference types intentionally. Data locations such as storage, memory, and calldata determine where reference data lives and how it can be modified.

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: A snippet that compiles is not automatically correct or secure. Check the selected compiler version, read every warning, assert preconditions, test reverting and edge cases, and inspect external-call assumptions. If a tool or opcode is unsupported, verify the compiler release and target-chain support instead of weakening checks.

content_blocks.text: Extend the small example to demonstrate Fixed-Size and Dynamically Sized Types. Write down the expected result before running it, add a normal test and a failure/boundary test, then note one design trade-off or security concern.

content_blocks.title: Recap and next step
content_blocks.text: Recap: Fixed-Size and Dynamically Sized Types should be understood alongside the module principle: Choose exact value types and reference types intentionally. Data locations such as storage, memory, and calldata determine where reference data lives and how it can be modified. Continue to the next lesson only after you can explain the behavior, reproduce the result locally, and state the important limitations.
